scope: HEC-RAS unsteady benchmark pipeline traceability for HydroClaude
notes: This registry is the single traceability source for modeling-basis and steady-basis IDs used by validation_cases/unsteady/*/case_metadata.json.
A same_physics_family steady basis is acceptable for active engineering work, but it is not equivalent to a same-project steady re-run.
planned_gap means the exact steady prerequisite is not yet backfilled and must be closed before claiming full three-stage closure.

Any future same-project steady prerequisite for this case requires creating and running a dedicated steady HEC-RAS plan from the Beaver bridge project inputs before new artifacts can be registered.
